nodes.name: Oxytocin System

nodes.name: eCB

nodes.name: BBB
nodes.function: Selective barrier protecting brain from peripheral immune signals, pathogens, toxins. Compromised by stress, inflammation, trauma.

nodes.name: Vagal Immune Axis
nodes.function: Inflammatory reflex — vagus nerve suppresses systemic inflammation via cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway. Brain monitors and controls immune response.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Disrupted → uncontrolled inflammation, autoimmune, rheumatoid arthritis. Vagus nerve stimulation targets this

nodes.name: SCN
nodes.function: Master circadian clock — 24-hour biological rhythm generator, light entrainment, cortisol patterning, sleep-wake cycle coordination.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Disrupted → circadian rhythm disorders, shift work disorder, jet lag, seasonal affective disorder, Alzheimer's

nodes.name: Pineal Gland
nodes.function: Melatonin secretion — darkness signal, sleep induction, antioxidant, potential endogenous DMT production (contested). The 'third eye' of ancient tradition.
nodes.dysregulation_hyper: Calcification (aging) → circadian disruption. Melatonin dysregulation → insomnia, jet lag, seasonal depression
nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Calcification (aging) → circadian disruption. Melatonin dysregulation → insomnia, jet lag, seasonal depression
nodes.business_mapping: Sleep supplement industry, melatonin pharma, sleep tracking tech, circadian lighting design, psychedelic research

nodes.name: Corpus Callosum
nodes.function: Primary interhemispheric bridge — transfers information between left and right hemispheres for integrated cognition, emotion-language integration.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Agenesis → disconnection syndrome. Severed → split-brain syndrome. Thinned → ASD, schizophrenia, TBI

nodes.name: Uncinate Fasciculus
nodes.function: Connects frontal lobe (emotional regulation, decision-making) with anterior temporal lobe (semantic memory, emotional memory). The emotion-reason bridge.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Disrupted → impaired emotional memory integration. Damaged in PTSD, borderline PD, antisocial PD

nodes.name: Arcuate Fasciculus
nodes.function: Primary language pathway — connects Broca's (production) and Wernicke's (comprehension) areas. Critical for language learning and reading.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Disrupted → conduction aphasia, dyslexia, language learning difficulty
nodes.business_mapping: Language learning platforms, dyslexia treatment, speech pathology, translation tech, literacy education companies

nodes.name: Cingulum Bundle
nodes.function: Major DMN white matter highway — connects mPFC, ACC, PCC, hippocampus, amygdala. Carries emotional-memory-self integration traffic.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Disrupted → depression, anxiety, PTSD. DBS of cingulum target for OCD and depression

nodes.name: Insular-Cingulate Network
nodes.function: The core salience network dyad — together they evaluate the significance of internal and external events and switch between DMN and task-positive networks.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Disrupted switching → depression (DMN stuck), anxiety (task network stuck), ADHD (poor switching)

nodes.name: Spinothalamic Tract
nodes.function: Ascending pain and temperature pathway from spinal cord to thalamus and cortex. The body's distress signal highway.

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Sensitized → chronic pain, allodynia, hyperalgesia

nodes.name: MNS

nodes.dysregulation_hypo: Imbalanced → emotional dysregulation, trauma responses, personality disorders, addiction
